title: Fault tolerance of quantum circuits with tensor networks and symplectic geometry
summary: We develop an operator-algebraic framework for analyzing fault tolerance in quantum circuits and establish necessary and sufficient conditions for exact recovery of the ideal computation under a prescribed noise model. For prescribed circuit families and noise models, we derive a semidefinite program (SDP) based test whose infeasibility certifies that there does not exist any recovery map restoring its intended operation.
